source.title: Sixteen Great Poems of Ifá
source.author: Wande Abimbọla
source.publisher: OAU Centre for Linguistic and Historical Studies by Oral Tradition (CELHTO), Niamey, Niger
source.notes: NOT CONSULTED — no lawfully accessible copy found. Bibliographic record verified against UNESCO's own catalogue (UNESDOC ark:/48223/pf0000019827) on 2026-07-28: 468 pp., illus., plurilingual English and Yorùbá, archives call number COM.COL.OR/AF.7. COMMONLY MISCITED as 'UNESCO 1975' — including in academic bibliographies. The primary record gives the imprint as Niamey: OAU CELHTO, 1975, country of publication Niger, with the note 'Pub. with the financial assistance of UNESCO' and source 'UNESCO-sponsored'. UNESCO funded it; the OAU published it, so copyright rests with CELHTO or the author and UNESCO's open-access policy does not reach it. UNESDOC states 'Full-text not available' and directs enquiries to library@unesco.org and archives@unesco.org. A scan exists at archive.org/details/sixteen-great-poems-of-ifa-wande-abimbola but is an individual's upload with no licence statement, outside controlled lending; treated as unauthorised. Legitimate routes: the two UNESCO addresses above, CELHTO directly, or a library holding call number 896(662.1) ABI.
